title: Revisiting episode 29 : Thinking on LLMs and GenAI
summary: Kahran and Divya take stock of what a few months of using LLMs has actually changed in how they think, work and play — using ChatGPT as a knowledgeable conversation partner for ergonomics, etymology, Turkish poetry translation, baby names, even worldbuilding a magic system. The frame is less 'what can AI do' and more 'how do the tools we use redesign us.'

intents.display: to hear how llms actually change the way you think and work
